QuestInfo.name: Every Whisker in its Right Place
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann's looking quite pleased with himself. He looks like he has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Get him a sweet comb from the  Baby Boulder Munchers at the Mine Entrance.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann will be grooming himself for the next few hours...

0.0: This nose-neighbor is a shining pinnacle of moisturized manhood! But... it's still missing something... \r\nYes, something YOU were supposed to get me!\r\n

yes.0: The secret of all fashion gurus is a well-made comb, and I don't have one of those! I hear the Boulder Munchers at the Mine Entrance do have nice combs and I am do not like being outdone by monsters. Rectify this injustice immediately!

no.0: Do you expect this beauty to go untended?! Savage!

item.0: I rarely say this, but please hurry. These whiskers are getting rather unruly.
